text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "La Section des affaires du Conseil fédéral (SACF) est au centre de l’activité gouvernementale.", "gist": "The Federal Council Affairs Section (SACF) is central to government activity."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2500", "gist": "2500 government affairs handled annually"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "40 à 60", "gist": "40 to 60 Council of Federal sessions per year"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "une centaine d’heures", "gist": "around 100 hours total duration of sessions per year"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Section des affaires du Conseil fédéral (SACF)", "gist": "Federal Council Affairs Section (SACF)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Conseil fédéral", "gist": "Federal Council"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Elle traite les quelque 2500 affaires que les départements et la Chancellerie fédérale soumettent annuellement au Conseil fédéral.", "gist": "It processes around 2500 cases submitted annually by departments and the Federal Chancellery to the Federal Council."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Elle planifie les séances du Conseil fédéral, élabore les ordres du jour, coordonne la procédure de co-rapport et prépare les décisions du Conseil fédéral.", "gist": "It is responsible for planning Council sessions, drafting agendas, coordinating co-reporting procedures, and preparing Council decisions."}]}
